title: bot.ability.memory.stm.turn
description: A turn of a conversation to remember: what the bot heard or said, who said it, and the words, bounded and cut at a whole word.

id.description: Id of the turn: for a heard turn the id of the speech event Listening handed on, for a said turn the provenance id of the event that committed the message, so a reader can tell the turn that is its own stimulus from the turns before it.
id.title: Id

direction.description: 'heard' for a message someone sent the bot, 'said' for a message the bot sent.
direction.title: Direction

speakers.description: Who said it, as their producers stamped them: the heard speech's source participants for a heard turn, the participants stamped on the bot's own message (its own voice) for a said turn. Empty when no producer stamped anyone, as for a voice nobody identified.

items.description: Someone who took part in a stimulus: an opaque, producer-stable identity reference and the role it played (source: who produced it; target: who it was addressed to).

ref.description: Opaque, producer-stable identity such as a phone number, an app person id, or a chat handle. Never a display name chosen by the bot.
ref.title: Ref

role.description: source: who produced the stimulus (speaker, sender). target: who it was addressed to.
role.title: ParticipantRole

own.description: True when the producer knows this participant is the bot itself, for example the bot's own voice heard back or the voice it spoke with. Stamped only by that producer; never inferred.
own.title: Own

resembles.description: For an identity its producer made just now (nobody it knew): the known identities it resembles, best first, at most 3. Stamped only by that producer; never a link.

items.description: A known identity this new one resembles: its ref and how similar the two are (-1..1). Perception data only: it links nothing, and it is never a print.

ref.description: The ref of the known identity, as its producer stamps it.
ref.title: Ref

similarity.description: How similar the two are, -1..1; higher is more alike.
similarity.title: Similarity

items.title: Resemblance

resembles.title: Resembles

items.title: Participant

speakers.title: Speakers

text.description: The words of the turn, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes, cut at a whole word.
text.title: Text

cut.description: True when the words were longer than the bound and ``text`` holds only their beginning.
cut.title: Cut

conversation.description: Id of the ability that recorded the turn: the Listening that heard it, or the Conversation that committed what the bot said.
conversation.title: Conversation
